say:0:1120702001:0.text: Wow, it's so lively here! It looks like they're preparing for some sort of event!
say:0:1120702001:0.source_cn: 哇，这里好热闹，好像在准备什么祭典呢！

say:1:1120702002:0.text: Magister, let's go ask the clan leader! Perhaps we can help.
say:1:1120702002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们去问问族长吧！说不定能帮上一些忙呢。
say:1:1120702002:0.male: Magister, let's go ask the clan leader! Perhaps we can help.
say:1:1120702002:0.female: Magister, let's go ask the clan leader! Perhaps we can help.

say:3:1120704001:0.text: Are you preparing for an event? The clan here seems very lively!
say:3:1120704001:0.source_cn: 族长爷爷，你们在准备祭典吗？部落内看起来很热闹的样子！

say:4:1120704002:0.text: *Sigh*... It's the <style="highlight">Bestial Brawl</style>. It's got me so stressed I want to butt heads with an ironjaw!

say:5:1120704003:0.text: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.
say:5:1120704003:0.male: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.
say:5:1120704003:0.female: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.

choice_prompt:6:1120704003.text: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.
choice_prompt:6:1120704003.source_cn: 这位魔法师<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，听说你见多识广，四处都有人脉。不知道你认不认识擅长斗兽的蛮血？
choice_prompt:6:1120704003.male: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.
choice_prompt:6:1120704003.female: I hear you're the magister who knows many throughout the desert. I wonder if you know any Maulers skilled at fighting and taming beasts.

say:7:1120704004:0.text: The participant has to be one of Mauler blood. This custom has been passed down through our generations. Made by us, bled by us...
say:7:1120704004:0.source_cn: 唉，不是蛮血可不行哟……这是代代传下来的规矩。演祀由蛮...

say:8:1120704005:0.text: The Dusk Lord would be furious if we strayed from tradition!
say:8:1120704005:0.source_cn: 要是违背了传统，残阳神肯定会更加震怒！

choice_prompt:9:1120704005.text: The Dusk Lord would be furious if we strayed from tradition!
choice_prompt:9:1120704005.source_cn: 要是违背了传统，残阳神肯定会更加震怒！

say:10:1120704006:0.text: The Bestial Brawl is an ancient ritual of worship for the Dusk Lord. In recent years, the Crimson Highlands have been plagued by frequent earthquakes and dark, mist-like creatures.
say:10:1120704006:0.source_cn: 斗兽演祀是自古以来祭祀残阳神的仪式，这几年来，深红高原...

say:11:1120704007:0.text: It's all thanks to the vile Quicksand Claws and those Syndicate scum! They set their sights on the resting place of the Dusk Lord, disrupting his peace and creating these abominations.
say:11:1120704007:0.source_cn: 都是黑金和流沙之爪那帮混蛋的错！他们盯上了残阳神的长眠...

say:12:1120704008:0.text: This is the wrath of the Dusk Lord! He delivers punishment upon the defilers of the Crimson Highlands!
say:12:1120704008:0.source_cn: 这是残阳神的怒火！祂在给深红高原的生灵降下惩罚！

say:13:1120704009:0.text: So the clans have banded together to host the Bestial Brawl, honoring the traditions of our forebears in the hopes of comforting the soul of the Dusk Lord and obtaining his leniency.
say:13:1120704009:0.source_cn: 所以，我们这几个部族决定按照祖辈的传统，联合起来举办一...

say:14:1120704010:0.text: Battling beasts sounds a bit dangerous...
say:14:1120704010:0.source_cn: 但，斗兽……这听起来不是很危险吗？

say:15:1120704011:0.text: We make no claim that it's not. Ironjaws are violent and difficult to tame, with only the worthiest able to break them. But it will take such Maulers to win the favor of the Dusk Lord.
say:15:1120704011:0.source_cn: 谁说不是哟。钢颚兽生性暴躁，难以驯服，只有最英勇的战士...

say:16:1120704012:0.text: Many of the clans' young Maulers were deceived by the Adamant Syndicate and the Quicksand Claws and never returned. Thus, gathering any to perform in the event is almost impossible.
say:16:1120704012:0.source_cn: 族内的青壮年，好些被黑金和流沙之爪骗去开掘洞穴，然后就...

say:17:1120704013:0.text: Well, have you sent anyone to Alkali to request aid from the other clans?
say:17:1120704013:0.source_cn: 嗯……族长爷爷，你们有没有去咸水镇和周边的部族找人帮忙？

say:18:1120704014:0.text: Diplomacy is not a common practice for us in the Crimson Highlands...
say:18:1120704014:0.source_cn: 这个……倒是没有。我们和深红高原外交流不太频繁……

say:19:1120704015:0.text: Then there's still hope! I recall that there are many powerful warriors in Alkali, so perhaps we can find Maulers willing to take up the challenge!
say:19:1120704015:0.source_cn: 那还有希望！我记得咸水镇上有很多很厉害的人，说不定就能...

say:20:1120704016:0.text: Magister, let's see what we can do!
say:20:1120704016:0.source_cn: 主人，我们去帮忙找找看吧！
say:20:1120704016:0.male: Magister, let's see what we can do!
say:20:1120704016:0.female: Magister, let's see what we can do!

choice_prompt:21:1120704016.text: Magister, let's see what we can do!
choice_prompt:21:1120704016.source_cn: 主人，我们去帮忙找找看吧！
choice_prompt:21:1120704016.male: Magister, let's see what we can do!
choice_prompt:21:1120704016.female: Magister, let's see what we can do!

say:22:1120704017:0.source_cn: 哎呀，我也是助人心切嘛……

say:23:1120704018:0.text: Yes! If any warriors are willing to participate in the event, we shall offer generous rewards!
say:23:1120704018:0.source_cn: 好啊，好啊！要是有勇士愿意来参加演祀，我们部族一定会拿...

say:24:1120704019:0.text: I'll draft a recruitment notice and leave the rest to you.
say:24:1120704019:0.source_cn: 我去写一张招募单，后面的事就麻烦你们了。

choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 你都这么说了，看来不去不行了

choice:9:0:1.text: A tradition of the Dusk Lord?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 这和残阳神有什么关系？
choice:9:0:1.male: A tradition of the Dusk Lord?
choice:9:0:1.female: A tradition of the Dusk Lord?

choice:9:1:2.text: Is this to honor the Dusk Lord?
choice:9:1:2.male: Is this to honor the Dusk Lord?
choice:9:1:2.female: Is this to honor the Dusk Lord?

choice:6:0:1.text: Does it have to be a Mauler?
choice:6:0:1.male: Does it have to be a Mauler?
choice:6:0:1.female: Does it have to be a Mauler?

choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 我倒是可以易容成蛮血……

say:0:1120706001:0.text: The elder said we need to find strong Maulers, but where to begin?
say:0:1120706001:0.source_cn: 族长爷爷说要找强壮灵巧的蛮血，咱们要怎么找人？
say:0:1120706001:0.male: The elder said we need to find strong Maulers, but where to begin?
say:0:1120706001:0.female: The elder said we need to find strong Maulers, but where to begin?

say:1:1120706002:0.text: It would be easier to nail the recruitment notice to a bulletin board than ask around one by one.
say:1:1120706002:0.source_cn: 比起一个一个人问过去，还是直接把招募单贴在告示板上更方便。

say:2:1120706003:0.text: Let's post the notice and see what happens.
say:2:1120706003:0.source_cn: 咱们把招募单贴上，然后等等看吧。
say:2:1120706003:0.male: Let's post the notice and see what happens.
say:2:1120706003:0.female: Let's post the notice and see what happens.

say:0:1120710001:0.text: Seems no one wants to join the Bestial Brawl...

say:1:1120710002:0.text: We have to keep asking around.
say:1:1120710002:0.male: We have to keep asking around.
say:1:1120710002:0.female: We have to keep asking around.

say:2:1120711001:0.text: I've heard some elders speak of the Bestial Brawl. They say you must face the ironjaws unarmed, squaring off against their deathly horns and relentless charging. One wrong move spells death.
say:2:1120711001:0.source_cn: 我倒是听长辈说过斗兽演祀的习俗，听说要赤手空拳和钢颚兽...

say:3:1120711002:0.text: It's a fine way to showcase skill and courage, but why risk your life just to please the Dusk Lord?
say:3:1120711002:0.source_cn: 虽然是展示勇气与技巧的好方法，但只是为了祭祀早已陨落的...

say:4:1120711003:0.source_cn: 会受伤？那果然还是算了。

say:5:1120711004:0.text: Life in town is peaceful enough. Why risk it just to show off?
say:5:1120711004:0.source_cn: 镇上的生活足够安宁，谁会只为展示自己去冒生命风险？

say:8:1120711005:0.text: Is there no one willing to join?!
say:8:1120711005:0.source_cn: 诶？！就……就没有一个人愿意帮帮忙吗？！

say:10:1120711006:0.text: I wouldn't mind claiming the reward, but the notice clearly says Maulers only! No humans? With my guns, I'm faster than any beast...
say:10:1120711006:0.source_cn: 哼，我倒是想拿悬赏，可招募令上说了，只要蛮血！人类就不...

say:11:1120711007:0.text: Alright, break it up. We've got business to handle.
say:11:1120711007:0.source_cn: 唉，散了，散了。还有生意要做呢。

say:0:1120712001:0.text: No takers... we have to keep trying.
say:0:1120712001:0.source_cn: 大家都不愿意帮忙……我们再找别人问问看吧。
say:0:1120712001:0.male: No takers... we have to keep trying.
say:0:1120712001:0.female: No takers... we have to keep trying.

say:1:1120712002:0.text: If we don't get lucky soon, we'll give the nearby Mauler clan a shot.
say:1:1120712002:0.source_cn: 嗯，如果还不行，就去附近的蛮血部落再试试。
say:1:1120712002:0.male: If we don't get lucky soon, we'll give the nearby Mauler clan a shot.
say:1:1120712002:0.female: If we don't get lucky soon, we'll give the nearby Mauler clan a shot.

say:0:1120714001:0.source_cn: 咦，前面闹哄哄的，发生什么了？

say:1:1120714002:0.text: There's a big argument up ahead! Let's get closer without causing trouble!
say:1:1120714002:0.source_cn: 骚乱是从前面传来的，我们过去看看吧，千万不要出什么乱子！
say:1:1120714002:0.male: There's a big argument up ahead! Let's get closer without causing trouble!
say:1:1120714002:0.female: There's a big argument up ahead! Let's get closer without causing trouble!

say:2:1120718001:0.text: You filthy Claws! You think the people here don't know what you've done?
say:2:1120718001:0.source_cn: 哼，你们这群流沙之爪，以为大家不知道你们做过什么事吗？！

say:3:1120718002:0.text: All the looting and kidnapping... just how many do you reckon you've harmed?!
say:3:1120718002:0.source_cn: 镇子周围的劫掠和绑架……你们害了多少人！

say:4:1120718003:0.text: I didn't do any of those things!

say:7:1120718004:0.text: Quit the innocent act! Since all the looting started, no supply caravans have come out here!
say:7:1120718004:0.source_cn: 少装无辜！自从你们开始劫掠，供货商队都不敢来！

say:8:1120718005:0.text: I've just been making soup! I haven't done anything wrong!
say:8:1120718005:0.source_cn: 卢玛一直在营地里煮汤，没——没做过坏事！

say:9:1120718006:0.text: The boss is gone... The Quicksand Claws are done... I just want to make an honest living! Please...
say:9:1120718006:0.source_cn: 头儿没了，流沙之爪也散了……\n卢玛只是想找点活儿干，...

say:10:1120718007:0.text: Are you gonna leave quietly or not? Scum like you should be tossed in the desert to fry in the sun! You aren't even good for the buzzards to eat!
say:10:1120718007:0.source_cn: 你走不走？像你们这种恶棍，就该丢到沙漠里暴晒，再喂给沙虫！

say:13:1120718008:0.text: There's no need for that. Plenty of folks here are offering rewards for a captured Quicksand Claw!
say:13:1120718008:0.source_cn: 用不着那么麻烦，有好些亲属被绑架的人悬赏流沙之爪的人头...

say:14:1120718009:0.text: Don't run too fast, little varmint. If my aim's off, you're in for a slow world of hurt.
say:14:1120718009:0.source_cn: 别跑得太快，小家伙。要是枪瞄不准，你的生命会结束得很痛苦……

say:3:1120719001:0.text: Well, who's this "hero"? What kind of crusader thinks it's worth saving a Claw?
say:3:1120719001:0.source_cn: 哪里冒出来的家伙，这么爱逞英雄，连流沙之爪也要救？
say:3:1120719001:0.male: Well, who's this "hero"? What kind of crusader thinks it's worth saving a Claw?
say:3:1120719001:0.female: Well, who's this "hero"? What kind of crusader thinks it's worth saving a Claw?

say:4:1120719002:0.text: How dare you slander Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s name! He's a renowned mage!
say:4:1120719002:0.male: How dare you slander Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s name! He's a renowned mage!
say:4:1120719002:0.female: How dare you slander Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s name! She's a renowned mage!

say:5:1120719003:0.text: I don't care if he's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!
say:5:1120719003:0.source_cn: 不管是魔法师还是找事的，老实闭上你们的嘴，不然我连你们...
say:5:1120719003:0.male: I don't care if he's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!
say:5:1120719003:0.female: I don't care if she's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!

choice_prompt:6:1120719003.text: I don't care if he's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!
choice_prompt:6:1120719003.source_cn: 不管是魔法师还是找事的，老实闭上你们的嘴，不然我连你们一起收拾！
choice_prompt:6:1120719003.male: I don't care if he's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!
choice_prompt:6:1120719003.female: I don't care if she's a mage or the village idiot. Shut your mouth, or I'll shut it for you!

say:7:1120719004:0.text: That's right! I wouldn't do anything bad!
say:7:1120719004:0.source_cn: 卢玛，是的……！卢玛，不做坏事！
say:7:1120719004:0.male: That's right! I wouldn't do anything bad!
say:7:1120719004:0.female: That's right! I wouldn't do anything bad!

say:8:1120719005:0.text: And you believe him? Would you believe me if I said I saw him robbing folks with my own eyes?
say:8:1120719005:0.source_cn: 他说了你就信？那我还说亲眼看见他抢劫，你信不信？
say:8:1120719005:0.male: And you believe him? Would you believe me if I said I saw him robbing folks with my own eyes?
say:8:1120719005:0.female: And you believe him? Would you believe me if I said I saw him robbing folks with my own eyes?

say:9:1120719006:0.text: Anyone who helps a Claw might as well be one themselves.
say:9:1120719006:0.source_cn: 你要帮他，那你也是流沙之爪的同伙。
say:9:1120719006:0.male: Anyone who helps a Claw might as well be one themselves.
say:9:1120719006:0.female: Anyone who helps a Claw might as well be one themselves.

say:10:1120719007:0.text: I guess it's time to collect a bounty!
say:10:1120719007:0.male: I guess it's time to collect a bounty!
say:10:1120719007:0.female: I guess it's time to collect a bounty!

say:4:1120720002:0.text: Step aside! I only want the Claw! Everyone else can go!
say:4:1120720002:0.source_cn: 让开，我只要那个流沙之爪，这是我能给出的最大让步！
say:4:1120720002:0.male: Step aside! I only want the Claw! Everyone else can go!
say:4:1120720002:0.female: Step aside! I only want the Claw! Everyone else can go!

say:5:1120720003:0.source_cn: 你——你这个蛮不讲理的家伙！

say:9:1120720005:0.text: You're good people! I don't want anyone to get hurt...
say:9:1120720005:0.source_cn: 你们……你们是好人！卢玛不想让任何人受伤……

say:10:1120720006:0.text: It's time I take a stand!

say:2:1120721001:0.text: No one's coming to save a Claw like you.
say:2:1120721001:0.source_cn: 流沙之爪臭名昭著，谁会帮你。

say:3:1120721002:0.source_cn: 好了，坦然面对你的命运吧……

say:4:1120721003:0.source_cn: 救……救命！卢玛——卢玛想活下去！

say:1:1120728001:1.text: They got off way too easy escaping like that.
say:1:1120728001:1.source_cn: 啧，竟然被他们逃走了，也太便宜他们了。
say:1:1120728001:1.male: They got off way too easy escaping like that.
say:1:1120728001:1.female: They got off way too easy escaping like that.

say:2:1120728002:1.text: The Claws wreaked all manner of havoc around here! Now that their leader's gone, they think they can just prance in here and play nice?!
say:2:1120728002:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪以前做了那么多坏事，现在倒好，头领一没，立刻就...
say:2:1120728002:1.male: The Claws wreaked all manner of havoc around here! Now that their leader's gone, they think they can just prance in here and play nice?!
say:2:1120728002:1.female: The Claws wreaked all manner of havoc around here! Now that their leader's gone, they think they can just prance in here and play nice?!

say:4:1120728004:1.text: If they ever show the faces around here again, I'll make sure they leave in a box!
say:4:1120728004:1.source_cn: 他们要是还敢来镇上，我非得让他们走着进来，躺着出去！
say:4:1120728004:1.male: If they ever show the faces around here again, I'll make sure they leave in a box!
say:4:1120728004:1.female: If they ever show the faces around here again, I'll make sure they leave in a box!

say:1:1120729001:1.text: Recently, we've had some Quicksand Claws milling around town. Puts people on edge.
say:1:1120729001:1.source_cn: 唉，最近镇上时不时能看到流沙之爪的身影，害得人提心吊胆。
say:1:1120729001:1.male: Recently, we've had some Quicksand Claws milling around town. Puts people on edge.
say:1:1120729001:1.female: Recently, we've had some Quicksand Claws milling around town. Puts people on edge.

say:2:1120729002:1.text: Seems they're all scatterbrained without any leadership. But after all they've done, there's no way they'll ever be welcome in Alkali.
say:2:1120729002:1.source_cn: 他们组织好像出了乱子，群龙无首了？但再怎么说，做过那些...
say:2:1120729002:1.male: Seems they're all scatterbrained without any leadership. But after all they've done, there's no way they'll ever be welcome in Alkali.
say:2:1120729002:1.female: Seems they're all scatterbrained without any leadership. But after all they've done, there's no way they'll ever be welcome in Alkali.

say:3:1120729003:1.text: We were under their thumb for so long, it was tough just get by. Now that we've caught our breath, we can't be fooled by those snakes!
say:3:1120729003:1.source_cn: 大家之前都是努力忍耐过来的，好不容易有了喘息的机会。决...

say:3:1120729003:1.female: We were under their thumb for so long, it was tough just get by. Now that we've caught our breath, we can't be fooled by those snakes!

choice_prompt:4:1120729003.text: We were under their thumb for so long, it was tough just get by. Now that we've caught our breath, we can't be fooled by those snakes!
choice_prompt:4:1120729003.source_cn: 大家之前都是努力忍耐过来的，好不容易有了喘息的机会。决不能被他们伪善的面孔欺骗！
choice_prompt:4:1120729003.male: We were under their thumb for so long, it was tough just get by. Now that we've caught our breath, we can't be fooled by those snakes!
choice_prompt:4:1120729003.female: We were under their thumb for so long, it was tough just get by. Now that we've caught our breath, we can't be fooled by those snakes!

say:5:1120729004:1.text: Quite a few. Some say they've turned over a new leaf, and others claim they were forced into doing the things they did.
say:5:1120729004:1.source_cn: 是啊，不少。有人说自己改邪归正，有人说自己是被逼无奈。
say:5:1120729004:1.male: Quite a few. Some say they've turned over a new leaf, and others claim they were forced into doing the things they did.
say:5:1120729004:1.female: Quite a few. Some say they've turned over a new leaf, and others claim they were forced into doing the things they did.

say:6:1120729005:1.text: Even if there's a bit of truth mixed in with the lies, this is retribution for the mess they made. Forgiveness doesn't come free around here!
say:6:1120729005:1.source_cn: 就算假话里掺了几句真话，那也是他们作恶的报应。不付出任...
say:6:1120729005:1.male: Even if there's a bit of truth mixed in with the lies, this is retribution for the mess they made. Forgiveness doesn't come free around here!
say:6:1120729005:1.female: Even if there's a bit of truth mixed in with the lies, this is retribution for the mess they made. Forgiveness doesn't come free around here!
